title: Two Cats and One Cat Trap
description: Sirius and Samoa are three- and four-month-old kittens respectively. They were so interested in a shoe box that their owners decided to see what would happen if a little “cat trap” was set up. It didn’t take much encouragement for both the rescue kittens to investigate. But in the end Sirius, the younger kitten, won out as Samoa was left caught in the ‘trap’. Credit: Amanda Whitney
